caption: An empty swing sways in the afternoon sun, and its shadow swings back and forth across the ground.

sa.check: A swing sways in the sun.
Its shadow swings back and forth across the ground.
The swing moves first and the shadow follows in time.

pc.expect: The shadow moves in time with the swing, stretching and shortening as the seat rises and falls.
pc.fail: It is still while the swing moves; or it swings out of time; or it keeps one length while the seat plainly rises.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the seat and chains' outline and stays joined to the frame's shadow.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or the chains' shadow detaches from the seat's; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The swing dies down and the shadow with it; nothing else moves the shadow.
pc.fail: The shadow swings with the seat still; or it swings harder as the seat dies down.
A second seat or shadow appears; or the seat vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or a chain detaches.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The swing and the playground stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The seat changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the ground changes.
